seo_title: Cost of Living in Sofia 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Sofia per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The most affordable EU capital: a path to the eurozone, low prices and straightforward bureaucracy for Russians. Sofia is popular for relocation via a business residence permit and schooling children at international schools.
pros: The most affordable EU capital: a business residence permit from €250,000
Prices lower than neighbouring Balkan countries
An active IT scene and residency at Sofia Tech Park
Proximity to the Vitosha mountains — skiing and trekking right by the capital
Russian is understood in cafés, pharmacies and services
cons: Bulgarian is needed for public services and healthcare
An ageing car fleet, traffic and some broken roads
Bureaucracy is tougher for Russians than in Podgorica or Serbia
Overcast and foggy in winter in the basin

visa_steps.title: Visa entry
visa_steps.description: Bulgaria has been in the Schengen Area since 2024, requiring a C or D visa. For Russians — via the embassy, taking 1–3 months.

visa_steps.title: Residence permit through work or business
visa_steps.description: Opening a company or a contract with a local employer grants a 1-year residence permit with renewal.

visa_steps.title: EIK and tax number
visa_steps.description: The identification code for business and taxes is issued via a notary within a couple of days.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: UBB, DSK and Postbank open accounts with a residence permit. Visa and MasterCard work without restrictions.

visa_steps.title: Permanent residence after 5 years
visa_steps.description: Permanent residence, then EU citizenship — the standard naturalisation path.

faq.question: Can I enter Sofia without a visa?
faq.answer: No, since 2024 Bulgaria has joined the Schengen Area — you need a visa or a residence permit from another Schengen country.

faq.question: How much does a business residence permit cost in Sofia?
faq.answer: The minimum contribution to the share capital is about €5,000, plus lawyer and notary fees.

faq.question: Is Sofia suitable for families?
faq.answer: Yes, there are international schools (Anglo-American School, AS Sofia) and a good market for private kindergartens.

faq.question: Is the climate harsh in Sofia?
faq.answer: Continental: summer +28°C, winter down to –5°C. Sofia lies in a basin, and fog is common in autumn.

faq.question: Can I work for a Russian company in Sofia?
faq.answer: Yes, through a local account and proof of income source for the tax authorities.

faq.question: What is healthcare like in Sofia?
faq.answer: Public healthcare is free for residents, but a private clinic like Acibadem or Sofiamed is usually faster.

reviews.text: I opened a Bulgarian LLC and moved with my wife and daughter. The school is international, rent in Lozenets is €700. Sofia is slow but stable.
Cheaper than expected: groceries, restaurants, healthcare. The downside is the local language. After a year I started speaking confidently.
